subject: Operations
title: From Raw Material to Customer
description: A short lesson to help you apply From Raw Material to Customer.

hook.text: Your morning coffee traveled 6,000 miles through dozens of hands before reaching your cup.

buildup.text: A supply chain links every step from raw material extraction to the finished product in a customer's hands.

discovery.text: It includes suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and the flows of goods, information, and money.

twist.text: No company controls its entire supply chain. Each link depends on the reliability of every other link.

climax.text: Managing a supply chain means orchestrating independent players toward a shared goal: customer satisfaction.

punchline.text: One chain. Many players. One shared goal.

quiz.question: What does a supply chain connect?
options: Raw materials to the final customer
